subject: Vendor onboarding: banking + PO preflight (EverPay)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@everpay.co>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: banking + PO preflight (EverPay)

Hi Samir —

Welcome — happy to kick off vendor onboarding for EverPay. To get you fully set up in our AP system and to avoid payment delays, could you please confirm the following items? I included a short vendor onboarding form as an attachment — please complete and return when convenient.

Quick checklist for banking/payment setup
- Preferred payment method: ACH (US) or wire? If wire, please include SWIFT/BIC and intermediary bank if required.
- Bank account details (you can redact full account numbers in email and share via secure portal) — we accept secure portal links or encrypted PDF.
- Remittance email address (where we should send remittance advices).
- Invoice submission preference: email to invoices@everpay.co, portal upload, or both?
- Payment terms requested (Net30, Net45, etc.). We typically run Net30 for new vendors unless otherwise approved.
- Legal/tax forms: W-9 (US vendors) or tax-exempt documentation (if applicable).
- PO requirement: Does EverPay require a PO number on invoices? If so, provide the preferred PO placement (invoice header, line item, or remittance).

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fill and return).

Next steps I propose:
1) You reply with the above items and preferred upload method for bank details.
2) Finance (cc’d) will confirm whether we can honor requested payment terms and set the vendor record.
3) We’ll issue an initial PO if required and confirm remittance instructions.

If there are any procurement docs you need from us (preferred invoice template, address for remittance, tax reporting name), let me know and I’ll attach them.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this wrapped up quickly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf
From: Samir Shah <samir@everpay.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: EverPay Finance <invoices@everpay.co>
Date: 2025-11-10T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: banking + PO preflight (EverPay)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the checklist and the warm welcome. See answers below and I’ve attached a redacted bank screenshot for your finance team to reference. We will upload full account details to our secure portal (link below) rather than send them in clear email.

- Preferred payment method: ACH (we prefer ACH for US transfers).
- Bank details: will provide via our secure portal: https://everpay.co/portal/secure-bank. Attached: bank_details_redacted.png (last 4 digits shown).
- Remittance email: invoices@everpay.co (please CC accounting@everpay.co on payment advices).
- Invoice submission: primary via portal (https://everpay.co/portal/invoices). We can accept emailed invoices to invoices@everpay.co if needed.
- Payment terms requested: Net30. Happy to accept Net30 for initial work.
- Tax form: we’ve attached our company W-9 on the portal (please confirm receipt).
- PO requirement: We do not require a PO to be paid but can include PO number on invoices if Redwood provides it.

Let us know what you need from procurement or finance to finish setup.

Cheers,
Samir Shah
Head of Finance Operations | EverPay Inc.
samir@everpay.co | +1 (212) 555-0199

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. Once you confirm you’ll include P-34872 on invoices and upload to your portal we’ll move vendor to active in the next payment run. Expect first settlement on Net30 cadence after invoice receipt.

Regards,
